query Records($tenantId: ID!, $filter: GetEventListFilter) {
      runTradeReport(tenantId: $tenantId, filter: $filter) {
        pageInfo {
          forwardCursor
          hasNextPage
        }
        records {
          knowledgeTime
          validTime
          type
          knowledgeEndTime
          assetType
          aexeoOrderId
          clientOrderId
          summa_id
          portfolioName
          brokerName
          basketName
          strategyName
          custodianAccountName
          custodianName
          managerName
          quantity
          price
          cost
          secFeeAmount
          exFeeAmount
          brokerCommissionAmount
          legalFeeAmount
          totalExpenseAmount
          actualSettleDate
          contractualSettleDate
        }
      }
    }
